      - heading "Common misconception" [level=2]:
        - img
        - text: Common misconception
      - paragraph: If trials are dependent or p changes from trial to trial, the binomial formula does not generally apply.
      - separator
      - text: "Not binomial when:"
      - paragraph: Player gets tired and p decreases. Weather changes affect p. One shot's outcome affects the next.
